title: Can I BEAT Stockfish in a Maze?
summary: Tony plays Fairy-Stockfish on a 12x10 board with randomly placed stone barrier blocks forming a 'maze'. Blocks cannot be entered or passed through, so pawns are nearly useless (can't reach promotion) and sliding pieces are hampered while knights jump freely. He gets close to winning a knight-vs-rook ending but it ends in a draw.
rules: Stone block squares are impassable: no piece may land on or slide through them; knights may jump over them.
Normal chess pieces and rules otherwise; opponent Fairy-Stockfish.
win_condition: Checkmate Fairy-Stockfish (video ended in a draw).
